summary: Depth mode on an NFO future: one book level, the open interest packet, day OHLC and the last trade, each a Depth frame with the one level Motilal sent; OI 1500 from the m packet on.

notes: The web publishes every subscription from its packet stores every 500 ms (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data); web.json holds the poll after each push, the desktop sends a frame when a packet changes what a subscription reports.
NFO registers as exchange NSEFO, segment D: wire character N, as NSE cash.

deviations.reason: A book Motilal sent before any quote packet reaches the Depth holder at once, with LTP 0 and no quote field (the 1.0.6 rule: a packet with no trade price still brings its book); the web publishes Depth only once a quote packet has also arrived (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data).

Before the first trade the book goes out with LTP 0 (the 1.0.6 rule: a depth frame keeps ltp and timestamp before the first quote) as a double, 0.0; the web's Depth dict sends the integer 0 from quote.get('ltp', 0). Same value, the desktop's number type.
No last-trade packet has arrived: the web's Depth dict sends volume 0 (quote.get('volume', 0)), a value it never received; the desktop leaves it out.

Motilal has sent book level 1 only; the web pads the four levels that never arrived with integer zeros ({"price": 0, "quantity": 0, "orders": 0}, _normalize_depth_data), invented levels; the desktop sends the level received (lead decision 2026-11-09: no invented level).

Motilal's last-trade packet carries the last traded quantity and the average price, and the web's Quote dict sends them, but its Depth dict drops them (motilal_adapter.py _normalize_depth_data): lost data. The desktop's Depth frame keeps them, the last quantity under Motilal's own name ltq (lead decision 2026-11-09: market data the broker sent is kept).
